# Ashwood Police Station third-party assets

All assets in `poly_haven/` were downloaded at 1K resolution on 2026-07-29
from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/) through its public asset API.
Poly Haven publishes these assets under
[CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Attribution is not legally required, but the project credits the authors and
source here.

| Local folder | Asset | Author / source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `poly_haven/ammo_box/` | [Ammo Box](https://polyhaven.com/a/ammo_box) | DanKit / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/signal_flashlight/` | [Signal Flashlight](https://polyhaven.com/a/signal_flashlight) | Jiří Ptáček / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/vintage_radio_transceiver/` | [Vintage Radio Transceiver](https://polyhaven.com/a/vintage_radio_transceiver) | Mateusz Sadek / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/Megaphone_01/` | [Megaphone 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/Megaphone_01) | Ethan Simon-Law / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/binder_notebook/` | [Binder Notebook](https://polyhaven.com/a/binder_notebook) | DaDrood / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/old_gas_mask/` | [Old Gas Mask](https://polyhaven.com/a/old_gas_mask) | Michał Wiśniewski / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |
| `poly_haven/security_camera_01/` | [Security Camera 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/security_camera_01) | Alexander Otterbeck and Yann Kervran / Poly Haven | CC0 1.0 |

The station scene also instances existing project assets without modifying
their source files: Poly Haven office furniture and fluorescent fixtures,
OpenGameArt sanitary fixtures, the existing CC0 door models, common crates,
and the existing dirty mattress. Their original license records remain with
those shared asset folders.
